pretreatment: standard cleaning, radical-oxygen oxidation by low temperature treatment
evidence: HfO2 films were deposited on the oxidized Si surface by showerhead-type ALD at a temperature of 300 °C. After standard cleaning, an ultrathin SiO2 layer with the thickness of ,1.5 nm was grown by radical-oxygen oxidation by low temperature treatment, prior to the HfO2 deposition.
